title: Originated lines: tuning, out-of-sample accuracy, calibration, defects

model.side: margin = h_rating - a_rating + home_field; ridge lambda=20; decay=0.90 per week; prior-season weight 0.35
model.total: total = mu + off_home + def_away + off_away + def_home; ridge lambda=20
model.moneyline: P(home) = Phi(margin/sigma) + half the tie mass; sigma from the walk-forward residuals of the same season, never the current week
model.walk_forward: refit before every week with only earlier weeks of the same season plus a decayed prior season

tuning.rule: lowest MAE on 1999-2014 only; frozen before the 2015-2026 test window was scored

honest_verdict.statement: The ratings model carries real information: it beats the naive 'home team by 2.5' baseline on side MAE. It does not beat the market. That is the expected result for a model with no information the market does not have, and it is published rather than hidden. No stake is staked on this model; it is a screen and the benchmark for the strategy layer.
